up: For the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5729657', list all distinct molecules that are reported in that document. Include the molecule's ChEMBL ID and preferred name. Base the query on the docs table (filtered by chembl_id), joined through activities to molecule_dictionary. Ensure each molecule is listed only once, regardless of how many times it appears in the document.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
    md.pref_name
FROM docs d
INNER JOIN activities a ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729657';
